children.title: AI Dependence and Reduced Autonomy in Athletes

detail.title: AI Dependence and Reduced Autonomy in Athletes
detail.summary: Recent cross-sectional evidence indicates that dependence on AI training recommendations is positively associated with body signal outsourcing, which correlates with reduced self-regulation, decision hesitation, and diminished training self-efficacy.
detail.reason: Revising notebook nb-emergent-prefs-001 using newly incorporated evidence from Chen (2026) to detail the serial association model.
